The '''''Kabalian Cross''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that was a part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]<ref name="EGTW" /> and measuring 1,600 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length,<ref name="DB" /> it shared its name with the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]<ref name="CSWE Kabal">{{CSWECite|II|189|Kabal}}</ref> and was in service around [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], when the Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and hero [[Shea Hublin]], [[Air Marshal]] of the [[Greater Seswenna/Legends|Greater Seswenna]] region, lost a [[Limb/Legends|leg]] and a half of his arm in an [[Ambush at Vale|ambush]] by anti-Imperial rebels, Hublin's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Eris Harro/Legends|Eris Harro]], demanded that he retire from the Imperial [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]]. Hublin subsequently took up a line [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] and led a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] from the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Kabalian Cross''. He then went on to earn the sobriquet "the Rebel Destroyer" and continued combating the rebels and criminals of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] for years.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Kabalian Cross'' was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
